component.name: Aethon
component.summary: Aethon manga reader powered by Suwayomi

description.p: Aethon is a desktop manga reader built on top of Suwayomi-Server (Tachidesk), providing a clean native interface for browsing, reading, and managing your manga library across hundreds of sources.
Svelte rewrite with improved UI, bundled server, and cross-platform fixes.
